screener_description: Kalyani Steels Ltd, a Kalyani Group specialty-steel company, manufactures forging and engineering-quality carbon /alloy-steel long products through the blast-furnace route. Its integrated Ginigera, Karnataka plant supplies critical grades for automotive, bearings, energy, oil & gas, engineering, seamless tube, defence and railway applications, with group forging companies as key customers.
